definitions.explanation: A hand tool with a sharp beveled edge used for carving, cutting, or shaping wood, stone, or metal. Typically struck with a mallet to drive it into the material.

examples.japanese: のみと{槌|つち}を{使|つか}って{木|き}を{彫|ほ}る。
examples.english: I carve wood using a chisel and mallet.

examples.japanese: {大工|だいく}さんがのみで{溝|みぞ}を{掘|ほ}った。
examples.english: The carpenter cut a groove with a chisel.

examples.japanese: のみの{刃|は}を{砥石|といし}で{研|と}いだ。
examples.english: I sharpened the chisel blade on a whetstone.

notes:
KANJI WRITING:
・{鑿|のみ} (rarely used, complex kanji)
・Usually written in hiragana

TYPES OF CHISELS:
・{追入|おいいれ}のみ (paring chisel - for fine work)
・{叩|たた}きのみ (firmer chisel - struck with mallet)
・{丸|まる}のみ (gouge - curved blade)
・{平|ひら}のみ (flat chisel)

RELATED TOOLS:
・{槌|つち}/{木槌|きづち} (mallet)
・かんな (plane)
・{砥石|といし} (whetstone)
・たがね (cold chisel - for metal)

COLLOCATIONS:
・のみを{入|い}れる (to apply the chisel)
・のみで{削|けず}る (to shave with a chisel)
・のみで{彫|ほ}る (to carve with a chisel)
・のみを{研|と}ぐ (to sharpen a chisel)
